Measurement procedure

The laboratory records temperature and pressure throughout each experiment. Consult the instrument calibration before interpreting a reading. Calibration accounts for systematic measurement errors.

The technician checks each instrument against a reference sample, then records the comparison in the laboratory notebook. Unusual observations require another measurement before the experiment can continue.

The results section describes the observations and units. The reference index explains how the procedures relate to other experiments. Each procedure should be followed in the stated order.

A complete appendix supplies additional context. The laboratory overview introduces the research program. The external reference provides an independent account of the method and its limitations.
